nodes.name: Daily 02:00 UTC
nodes.notes: First of the four daily workflows. The last one to run (FTS) is the one that sets triggerScoring.

nodes.name: Get active crises
nodes.notes: Cohort comes from the API rather than being hardcoded here, so the country list cannot drift between the workflow and the database.

nodes.name: GDELT DOC 2.0
nodes.notes: One request every 6s — GDELT's own throttle notice demands one per 5s, verified live on 2026-07-20 (it returns a plain-text warning, not JSON, when exceeded). 26 countries therefore takes ~3min, which is fine on a nightly schedule. onError=continue so one bad country cannot abort the run.

nodes.name: POST to Lumen API
nodes.notes: Secret is read from the environment, never stored in this file — it is committed to git.
